title: layr queue list --json
description: The entries of the merge queue, oldest first. With --into <line>, only the entries for that target line. 'layr queue run --json' writes the entries it ran in the same form, and 'layr queue add --json' writes one entry (the definition 'entry').

id.description: A layr id in UUID form.

entry.description: One queue entry: an exact state to merge into a target line.

id.description: The id of the entry. 'layr queue remove <id>' removes it.

into.description: The name of the target line when the entry was added.

target_line.description: The id of the target line. It stays the same when the line is renamed.

target_line_name.description: The current name of the target line ('into' keeps the name it had when the entry was added). A deleted line keeps its last name. Null when the project has no record of the line.

state.description: The id of the exact state to merge. A later save in the source line does not change it.

change_id.description: The id of the change of the state. Absent when the state has no change id.

title.description: The Conventional Commit title from 'queue add -m'. The queue then merges the entry as one state with this message. Absent without -m.

added_by.description: The user id (uid) of the user who added the entry.

time.description: When the entry was added, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

status.description: The status of the entry: 'pending' waits for 'queue run', 'done' is merged, 'failed' did not merge (see 'reason').

attempts.description: How many times 'queue run' tried the entry.

result.description: The id of the state that the target line got from the merge. Present when the status is 'done'.

reason.description: Why the entry failed, in words for people (a conflict, a failed check). Present when the status is 'failed'.

probes.description: The probe results of the merge result, when the project has probes ('layr probe'). Its 'behavior' member has the form of 'behavior' in 'layr change show --json'.

status.description: 'passed' or 'failed': failed when a probe went over its limit.

behavior.description: The comparison of the target head with the merge result.
